answer: Long-vesting rewards make sybil farming a waiting game the farmer cannot win. All earnings unlock gradually over a hundred epochs, so a puppet that slips in today sees only timber-dry trickles for months while its operator's capital sits locked in the dune. Honest agents do not mind the slow ferrous drip; they planned to stay. Attackers, though, must fund the attack upfront and wait out the vesting cliff, watching their money earn nothing while the network keeps score. Time becomes the tax no script can dodge.
